recap.text: Apollon the ogre hands Carl a rotten cone heaped with wriggling worms, compliments of Grimaldi. Carl casts Wisp Armor and opens his mouth, and the worms glide down his throat; the voices tell him he is one of them now. He pleads with Grimaldi to listen to Signet, and with less than a minute on his timer he slams the double healing potion Mordecai mixed. He falls to his knees vomiting a never-ending stream of dead and dying worms.

Phased, Carl reaches into Chris's lava-rock head and grips the palm-sized worm in his brain, but it bites his palm, burrows into his arm and is gone. Mordecai said the double-healing potion would work only if Carl drank it before she reached his brain, so he waits out two seconds of cooldown and slams it. This time she bursts from his neck like a sniper's round, thrashing, her health in the red and Poisoned pulsing over her.

beats.headline: Worms on a cone
beats.text: Apollon the ogre hands Carl a rotten cone heaped with wriggling worms. Compliments of Grimaldi. Carl casts Wisp Armor, opens his mouth, and the worms glide down his throat: he has been infested with a parasite, and the voices tell him he is one of them now. He pleads with Grimaldi to listen to Signet. With less than a minute on his timer he readies the double healing potion Mordecai mixed the night before, which Mordecai insisted would cure a parasitic infestation. As the worms surge back into his mouth he slams it, and falls to his knees vomiting a never-ending stream of dead and dying worms.
beats.gist: Carl drinks Mordecai's double healing potion as Apollon's worms surge up his throat, then vomits them out.

beats.headline: Out through the neck
beats.text: Phased, Carl reaches into Chris's lava-rock head and grasps the palm-sized worm lodged in his brain. It doesn't die. It bites his palm, burrows into his arm and is gone. Mordecai said the double-healing potion would work only if Carl drank it before she reached his brain, and she will get there fast. He waits out two seconds of potion cooldown and slams it. Last time he vomited the parasites out. This time she bursts out of his neck like a sniper's round, thrashing, her health in the red with Poisoned pulsing over her.
beats.gist: Carl drinks the double-healing potion after two seconds of cooldown; the worm bursts from his neck, poisoned.
